newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai fruit seller unwittingly defuses live bomb.
newsitem.headline: Thai fruit seller unwittingly defuses live bomb.

text.p: A Thai fruit seller, who unwittingly took home a bag containing a powerful time-bomb from a shop, narrowly escaped death when she defused it and then used it as a makeshift pillow, police said on Wednesday.
Malee Boonyung, 46, only realised that she had diced with death when a powerful pre-dawn blast at the shop near her home in downtown Saphankwai woke her.
She went out to investigate the blast and saw police retrieve an unexploded bomb from a bag similar to the one she had taken home.
The blast tore down the shop's iron gate and a wall.
Malee later confessed to police she had taken a similar, unattended bag that was hanging on the shop's fence the night before and dismantled a "strange object" in it.

Bomb disposal experts who arrived at the scene were baffled to find that Malee had already defused the bomb made with four sticks of dynamite. "She was lucky that the bomb was not timed to explode when she handled it," said one of the experts.
Police believe those responsible for bombing the shop had placed fresh bags containing bombs at the fence after discovering the first bag had been taken.
